name: SpreadX
description:
SpreadX connects Claude to your authorized SpreadX workspace so users can securely access business data, review sales summaries, check products and inventory, view contacts and payment methods, and create draft online orders for review inside SpreadX.

The connector is designed for teams that want to use natural language to understand sales performance and prepare order drafts faster. Access is controlled by SpreadX user permissions and OAuth authorization.

Supported actions include:
- Viewing sales summaries
- Checking products and inventory levels
- Reviewing contacts and payment methods
- Creating draft online orders for approval inside SpreadX

SpreadX does not finalize orders, charge payment methods, transfer money, or submit transactions directly through Claude. Draft orders must be reviewed and completed inside SpreadX.

_published_faq.name: How do I add SpreadX to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add SpreadX to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.spreadx.ae/lite/api/admin/v2/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the SpreadX MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: SpreadX provides these MCP tools: get_contacts, get_payment_methods, get_products, get_sales_summary, and place_online_order.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to SpreadX?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to SpreadX in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
SpreadX requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
SpreadX is developed by Spread Tech. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
